\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

గణన:

\n\n

దుకాణదారుడు వస్తువును విక్రయించే ధర = 100

\n\n

ప్రశ్న ప్రకారం:

\n\n

అతను 100లో 75%కి విక్రయితే 10% నష్టపోతాడు

\n\n

100లో 75% = 75

\n\n

75 అనేది కొనుగోలు ధరలో 90%

\n\n

⇒ 90% = 75

\n\n

⇒ 1% = 75/90

\n\n

⇒ 100% = (75/90)x 100 = 250/3

\n\n

కొనుగోలు ధర = 250/3

\n\n

విక్రయ ధర = 100 అని మనం అనుకున్నాం

\n\n

లాభం = 100 - (250/3) = 50/3

\n\n

⇒ లాభ శాతం = [(50/3) / (250/3] x 100 = [50/250] x 100 = 20%

\n\n

∴ కావలసిన శాతం = 20%

Given:

\n\n

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

\n\n

ఇచ్చినవి:

\n\n

4 సంవత్సరాల క్రితం A మరియు B వయసుల నిష్పత్తి = 5 : 7

\n\n

4 సంవత్సరాల తర్వాత A మరియు B వయసుల నిష్పత్తి = 7 : 9

\n\n

గణన:

\n\n

స్థిరాంకం x అనుకుందాం

\n\n

4 సంవత్సరాల క్రితం A మరియు B వయసులు = 5x మరియు 7x

\n\n

ప్రశ్న ప్రకారం:

\n\n

⇒ (5x + 8) / (7x + 8) = 7 / 9

\n\n

⇒ 45x + 72 = 49x + 56

\n\n

⇒ 4x = 16

\n\n

⇒ x = 4

\n\n

A మరియు B ప్రస్తుత వయసులు =

\n\n

A ప్రస్తుత వయసు = 5 x 4 = 20 + 4 = 24

\n\n

B ప్రస్తుత వయసు = 7 x 4 = 28 + 4 = 32

\n\n

12 సంవత్సరాల తర్వాత A వయసు = 24 + 12 = 36

\n\n

12 సంవత్సరాల తర్వాత B వయసు = 32 + 12 = 44

\n12 సంవత్సరాల తర్వాత A వయసు : 12 సంవత్సరాల తర్వాత B వయసు = 9 : 11", "mr": "

    • As soon as means at the moment (that); when.

    • So that means to show purpose or to give an explanation.
      • \n\t\t
    • And is used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly.
      • \n\t\t
    • Whereas means in contrast or comparison with the fact that.
      • \n\t
    \n\t
    • \n\t
  • Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
    \n\t

\n\n

The correct answer is "and also".

\n\n

Key Points

\n\n
    \n\t
  • In the given sentence, the conjunction 'and' used is incorrect. We know with "not only", we use "but also" in a sentence.
    • \n\t
  • "Not only" and "but also" are correlative conjunctions work in pairs to join words, phrases, or clauses.
    • \n\t
  • The construction "not only....but also" is called correlative conjunction. It is used to present two related pieces of information.
    • \n\t
  • Both pieces of information are being presented by the writer as surprising or unexpected, with the second one being even more surprising than the first.
    • \n\t
  • The first piece of information comes after not only, and the second piece of information comes after but also.
    • \n\t
  • Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
    \n\t 
    • \n
\n\n

Correct Sentence: He not only got a scholarship but also a good job.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n\n
    \n\t
  • Correlative conjunctions work in pairs to join words, phrases, or clauses. The correlative conjunctions are either...or, neither...nor, both...and, not only...but also, whether...or.
    • \n

Key Points

      • \n\t\t
    • The preposition 'for' usually tells us about the use of something, a reason or purpose.
      • \n\t\t
    • The preposition 'with' means accompanied by another person or thing.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n\n
    \n\t
  • A preposition is a word used to link nouns, pronouns, or phrases to other words within a sentence.
    • \n\t
  • They act to connect the people, objects, time and locations of a sentence.
    • \n\t
  • Prepositions are usually short words, and they are normally placed directly in front of nouns.
    • \n

    • प्रीपोज़िशन 'With' का अर्थ है किसी अन्य व्यक्ति या चीज़ के साथ।

        • \n\t
      • Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
        \n\t 
        • \n
      \n\n

      Correct Sentence: You need to curb your temper or you might offend someone.

      \n\n

      Hinglish

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • दिए गए रेखांकित खंड में 'offended' क्रिया का पिछला रूप गलत है।
        • \n\t
      • 'might' शब्द एक क्रियात्मक क्रिया है और क्रिया 'offended' दिए गए वाक्य में इसका अनुसरण कर रही है।
        • \n\t
      • मोडल क्रियाओं का पालन करने वाली क्रियाएं केवल उनके मूल रूप में होनी चाहिए। उन्हें कभी भी दूसरे रूप में संयुग्मित नहीं किया जाना चाहिए।
        • \n\t

      Directions: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

      \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "doing it"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "did it"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "do it"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "does it"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

      The correct answer is "do it".

      \n\n

      Key Points

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • In the given sentence, the auxiliary modal verb 'won't' is used.
        • \n\t
      • Won’t is a contraction of ‘will not’, used to express the future.
        • \n\t
      • After 'won’t' we use the bare infinitive.
        • \n\t
      • From the given options, only 'do' is the bare infinitive.
        • \n\t
      • Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
        \n\t 
        • \n
      \n\n

      Complete Sentence: I told him to avoid fighting, but he won’t do it.

      \n\n

      Hinglish

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • दिए गए वाक्य में, सहायक क्रियात्मक क्रिया 'won't' का प्रयोग किया गया है।
        • \n\t
      • भविष्य को व्यक्त करने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले ‘will not’ का संकुचन Won’t होगा।
        • \n\t
      • 'won’t' के बाद हम बेयर इनफिनिटिव का उपयोग करते हैं।
        • \n\t
      • दिए गए विकल्पों में से केवल 'do' ही साधारण क्रिया है।
        • \n\t
      • अतः सही उत्तर option 3 है।
        • \n
      \n\n

      Additional Information

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • Most infinitive structures begin with ‘to’, but sometimes the ‘to’ is omitted. This is known as the bare infinitive or the base form.
        • \n\t
      • Bare infinitives are used after auxiliary modal verbs: will, shall, would, could, can, may, might, must, should, needn't.
        • \n
